items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Frank Paday? He used to run that place. He's a white fellow.

ctx.x: What was his name again? I couldn't, I don't, a lot of these names, you know, fresh names.
Frank Paday? He used to run that place. He's a white fellow. How's it spelled?
Police. Paday and Pierre. I don't know how it spelled.
